summary: The latest iteration replaced a comprehensive simulation with a no-op stub and an embedded log line that is not valid Python. This caused an immediate syntax failure and removed all simulation functionality. In addition, prior code (iter_15) contained a critical syntax bug (an extra closing parenthesis) and several logic issues (household construction, environment flags not restored, potential timeouts). This feedback identifies critical blockers, proposes concrete code fixes (with before/after snippets), and provides prioritized next steps to restore functionality, improve robustness, and better align with real-world data.

critical_issues.issue: Non-Python text embedded in source: 'Error: Request timed out.'
critical_issues.impact: Immediate SyntaxError at import/execute; entire program fails before doing anything.
critical_issues.solution: Remove the stray text line from the source and keep only valid Python statements.

critical_issues.issue: Entire simulation replaced by a no-op main() stub
critical_issues.impact: All functionality removed; no simulation, no outputs, no artifacts; verification fails due to missing behavior.
critical_issues.solution: Restore the full simulation implementation from iter_15 (or iter_16 prior to overwrite), fix known syntax and logic errors, and ensure the entry point calls main() directly per sandbox requirement.

critical_issues.issue: Syntax error in prior iteration: extra closing parenthesis in seed_all call
critical_issues.impact: Program fails at runtime during the main setup even if the larger code is restored.
critical_issues.solution: Fix the line to have balanced parentheses: seed_all(int(params.get('random_seed', 42))).

critical_issues.issue: Calibration and evaluation flow can cause long runtimes/timeouts
critical_issues.impact: Timeouts in CI/sandbox environments; non-determinism in verification; potential repeated heavy runs.
critical_issues.solution: Gate runtime-heavy paths behind QUICK_TEST or environment flags, reduce default calibration budget, and restore env flags after temporary changes.

critical_issues.impact: Agents may be distributed across households unpredictably; household sizes do not match intended distribution; can distort homophily and within-household effects.
critical_issues.solution: Use generated household sizes to assign agent indices directly; avoid the later uniform block reassignment that discards size sampling.

critical_issues.issue: Environment variable DISABLE_EARLY_STOP set but not restored in evaluate_params
critical_issues.impact: Subsequent runs may unintentionally disable early stopping, changing outcomes and wasting time.
critical_issues.solution: Preserve the previous value and restore it in a finally block.

critical_issues.issue: Duplicated prev_mask_use state assignment in Simulation.run commit
critical_issues.impact: Redundant work and minor readability issue; potential confusion during maintenance.
critical_issues.solution: Remove the duplicate assignment to self.state['prev_mask_use'].

critical_issues.issue: Potential JSON parsing issues in external systems (trailing commas, NaNs)
critical_issues.solution: Continue to sanitize JSON via _json_clean and ensure allow_nan=False everywhere; validate no trailing commas in produced artifacts.

model_improvements.current_approach: Create households with sampled 'size' but later reassign members using uniform chunks, discarding sampled sizes.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Respect the sampled sizes when assigning agents to households; fill households sequentially until sizes are met.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic within-household structure and homophily, improving peer influence dynamics and adoption patterns.

model_improvements.current_approach: Policy uses incentive_amount and enforcement probability; adoption utility adds a simple additive term.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Make policy strength a function of both enforcement and mandate status (e.g., policy_strength = incentive + alpha*enforcement_active), and allow heterogeneity via trust_in_authority.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More nuanced response to policy, better capturing observed effects when mandates are active.

model_improvements.current_approach: Random search with default budget can be heavy; SNPE stub falls back to random search with no gating.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Reduce default budget to 5–10 for CI; use QUICK_TEST to skip calibration or cap steps; restore env flags after calibration.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Avoids timeouts and improves reliability in automated verification while retaining calibration capabilities offline.

model_improvements.current_approach: Exposures propagate from adopters to non-adopters with a degree bias and a decaying memory.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Introduce influence heterogeneity using 'is_influencer' and degree centrality; cap exposures by contact budget rather than max_exposures_per_day only.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Closer alignment to real-world diffusion via super-spreaders and limited daily communication budgets.

model_improvements.current_approach: Agents consume one mask per day if used; restock is proportional to population.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Introduce purchase lead-time or stockouts with backorders; vary restock rate over time; track mask shelf-life for more realistic consumption.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: More realistic supply constraints and usage patterns that can modulate adoption peaks.

code_improvements.modification: Remove stray text line 'Error: Request timed out.'
code_improvements.reason: It is not valid Python and directly causes a SyntaxError.

code_improvements.modification: Fix extra closing parenthesis in seed_all call: from seed_all(int(params.get('random_seed', 42)))) to seed_all(int(params.get('random_seed', 42))).
code_improvements.reason: Syntax fix to prevent runtime failure.

code_improvements.modification: Remove duplicate assignment to self.state['prev_mask_use'] in the commit phase.
code_improvements.reason: Eliminates redundancy and minor confusion; improves readability.

code_improvements.modification: Preserve and restore DISABLE_EARLY_STOP environment variable using try/finally.
code_improvements.reason: Prevents side effects across runs and reduces risk of unintended behavior and timeouts.

code_improvements.modification: Respect sampled household sizes when assigning members; remove later uniform reassignment loop.
code_improvements.reason: Aligns the constructed population to intended household size distribution.

code_improvements.modification: Gate calibration under QUICK_TEST with budget=0 and skip if desired; ensure end-to-end run completes quickly by default in CI.
code_improvements.reason: Avoids timeouts and ensures predictable verification performance.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Potential early fast saturation due to high peer weight and policy modeling.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Calibrate base_rate, peer_weight, enforcement_probability jointly using early-phase ground truth (first 20-40% of series) to match logistic growth slope.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Potential overestimation of compliance when enforcement is active.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce heterogeneity in enforcement response (e.g., beta distribution on trust_in_authority) and calibrate to observed compliance levels.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Flat or noisy estimates due to simple stance sampling.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Use time-varying media stance distributions (e.g., more anti during specific windows) and credibility variance tied to risk signal to match observed spikes.

prioritized_actions: Remove the stray 'Error: Request timed out.' line and restore the full simulation code.
Fix the syntax bug in main() seed_all call and re-run verification.
Add QUICK_TEST gating and restore env flags after evaluation to prevent timeouts.
Fix household assignment to respect sampled sizes.
Clean commit phase (remove duplicate prev_mask_use assignment).
Reduce default calibration budget and skip in QUICK_TEST.
Optionally add influencer heterogeneity in communication dynamics for better realism.
